This code can\'t be read. Show a new one on your computer and try again.
That isn\'t an OXESpace pairing code. Point the camera at the code in Settings › Devices.
This code points outside your local network. OXESpace only pairs on the same Wi-Fi.
This code comes from a different version of OXESpace. Update the app or OXESpace on your computer.
Camera access is off for OXESpace. Turn it on in the phone\'s settings to scan the pairing code.
Camera view for scanning the pairing code
The camera reads the pairing code on your computer\'s screen. Nothing it sees leaves the phone.
Done
The code expired. Show a new one on your computer and scan it within 2 minutes.
That code wasn\'t accepted. Show a new one on your computer and scan it again.
That code was already used. Show a new one on your computer.
Too many pairing attempts. Wait 2 minutes and try again.
Your computer answered in a way this app doesn\'t understand. Update the app or OXESpace on your computer.
Pairing was declined on the computer.
Your computer already has 5 paired devices. Remove one in Settings › Devices first.
Couldn\'t reach your computer. Check that it\'s on, on the same Wi-Fi, and that the phone connection is on in Settings › Devices.
Another device answered at that address, not your computer. Nothing was sent. Check that you\'re on your own Wi-Fi.
On your computer, open OXESpace › Settings › Devices, turn on the phone connection, and point the camera at the code shown there.
